lines.text: Many learners say: Most of people like music.
Most people! Most people like music.

native.tip: ‘대부분의 사람들’의 ‘의’를 of로 옮기기 쉬워요. 그냥 most people! 이렇게 말해요 👉 “Most people like music.”
native.caption: “Most of people like music”처럼 말하고 있나요? 😅 ‘대부분의 사람들’의 ‘의’를 of로 옮기기 쉬워요. 사람 전체를 말할 때는 of 없이 most people이라고 해요. 맞는 문장 ✅ “Most people like music.” Ama 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.

en.tip: Do not add of. Say most people. Say “Most people like music.”
en.caption: Do you say “Most of people like music” in English? 😅 You do not add “of” here, so say “most people”! “Most people like music” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
